desc:
DONT BUY THE GAME UNLESS YOU HAVE KEYBOARD AND MOUSE

ARMO is a realistic tactical first-person shooter inspired by Arma Reforger, focusing on teamwork, communication, and large-scale military combat. The game features realistic weapon mechanics, an advanced medical system, squad coordination, and tactical gameplay.

ARMO is currently in early alpha and is still under active development. Many features are unfinished, and you may encounter bugs, glitches, performance issues, or unexpected changes during gameplay.

The game currently has paid access, but it will become completely free upon its official release. Purchasing early access is optional and does not provide any exclusive gameplay advantages. Please keep in mind that you are paying for an unfinished game that will eventually be available to everyone for free.

Thank you for supporting the development of ARMO.
